name: MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certification Scheme
summary: Subsidised Zero Defect Zero Effect certification for MSME manufacturers, covering most of the certification cost and unlocking downstream benefits such as higher credit guarantee coverage.
administering_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
implementing_agency: Quality Council of India and empanelled assessment bodies
benefit_description: Subsidy of 80% for micro, 60% for small and 50% for medium enterprises on certification cost, with an additional 10% for enterprises owned by women, SC or ST entrepreneurs or located in NER, Himalayan, LWE-affected, island or aspirational districts.

criteria.description: The enterprise must hold a valid Udyam registration.
The enterprise should be engaged in manufacturing. ZED assessment is built around manufacturing practices, so pure service businesses are outside its scope.
The enterprise must be willing to undergo assessment against the ZED parameters and to pay its share of the certification cost in advance of each surveillance assessment.
criteria.source_quote: The MSME shall require to pay the beneficiary contribution in advance (as applicable) at the beginning of each Surveillance Assessment.

document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Self-declare on the Udyam portal using PAN and Aadhaar.

document_requirements.document_name: Category certificate, if claiming the additional 10% subsidy
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Apply at the tehsil or district office, or via your state e-district portal. Only needed if you are claiming the women, SC or ST top-up.
document_requirements.source_quote: There will be an additional subsidy of 10% for the MSMEs owned by Women/SC/ST Entrepreneurs OR MSMEs in NER/Himalayan/LWE/Island territories/aspirational districts.

windows.notes: Open on a rolling basis through the ZED portal.

benefits.description: Subsidised ZED certification at 80% for micro, 60% for small and 50% for medium enterprises, plus 10% for women, SC or ST owned enterprises and specified regions, and a further 5% for enterprises in a SFURTI or MSE-CDP cluster.
benefits.conditions_for_disbursement: Paid as a reduction in certification cost rather than as cash to the enterprise.
benefits.source_quote: 80%-60%-50% for Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises respectively.
